text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 381, dated
July 7, 1950, is hereby amended by increasing and setting
up new ceiling prices for Hills Bros. ard Mello-Cup coffee
and Pork and Beans, as follows.
FOODSTUFFS (IMPORTED)
Wholesaler's
COFFEE, ROASTED:
Hills Bros. Coffee
Mello-Cup Coffee
MEAT, CANNED:
Pork and Beans

Section 1 of Executive Order No. 343, dated
August 14, 1950, is hereby amended by increasing and
setting up new ceiling prices for Gold Medal Enriched
Flour as follows:
FLOUR, WHEAT:
Gold Medal Enriched Flour
Gold Medal Enriched Flour
Gold Medal Enriched Flour

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of October, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EvANGELISTA.
Executive Secretary
